ApprovalDecidedSignal.description: Parent to child: the decision the parked agent is waiting for.
ApprovalDecidedSignal.title: ApprovalDecidedSignal

AttemptFinishedSignal.description: Child AttemptWorkflow to parent, sent to the workflow id without a run id.
AttemptFinishedSignal.title: AttemptFinishedSignal

AttemptResumedPayload.description: A Temporal retry inside the same attempt, e.g. after a worker crash.
AttemptResumedPayload.title: AttemptResumedPayload

Budget.description:
Limits. A missing field means no limit at this level.

Money is in micro-dollars so both languages keep it exact.
Budget.title: Budget

CompletionProposal.description: Update ``proposeCompletion``. Completion is a claim until verified (04 §5).
CompletionProposal.title: CompletionProposal

ConnectorSnapshot.description:
An MCP connector as the worker connects to it (15 M8): names and launch targets, never secret values.
Control resolves the tenant's connector to this when the configuration is set, so a running task keeps the
connector it was given even if the tenant's list changes.
ConnectorSnapshot.title: ConnectorSnapshot

DeclareBlockedOp.description: An agent says its own node cannot proceed (05 §2, agent rights).
DeclareBlockedOp.title: DeclareBlockedOp

EntityRef.description: Consumers keep, per entity, only the highest version they have seen (09 §1).
EntityRef.title: EntityRef

PlanChangeCommand.description: Update ``submitPlanChange``. The whole command applies or none of it does.
PlanChangeCommand.title: PlanChangeCommand

PlanChangeRejected.description: No full graph here: Update results land in history (04 §4.1).
PlanChangeRejected.title: PlanChangeRejected

PlanView.description: Query ``getPlan``: the graph as the asking actor may see it.
PlanView.title: PlanView

Policy.description:
What an attempt may do (05 §6). Every layer (tenant, task, profile) can carry one; layers only tighten each
other: `denied_tools` add up and the smallest `exploration_max_tool_calls` wins. A missing field limits nothing.
Policy.title: Policy

SendMessageInput.description: Update ``sendMessage``; ``client_message_id`` doubles as the command id.
SendMessageInput.title: SendMessageInput

TaskConfig.description:
What a task runs with, beside its goal (15 M8). `expert` replaces the task's profile for nodes that do not
name their own; `skills` and `connectors` are the complete sets to use, and None means the expert's defaults.
A change takes effect from the next attempt, never in the one that is running (11 §3).
TaskConfig.title: TaskConfig

TaskConfigChangedPayload.description: What the task runs with from its next attempt on. Connector ids only: the launch targets stay out of events.
TaskConfigChangedPayload.title: TaskConfigChangedPayload

Team.description:
A leader and members. The leader's expert plans the task; a node the leader gives to a role runs as that member's
expert, and one it gives to nobody runs as the leader. Teams do not nest (07 §1: depth 1).
Team.title: Team

TeamMember.description: One member of a team (15 M8, T8.6): a role the leader can give work to, and the expert who does it.
TeamMember.title: TeamMember

TeamStageSpec.description: Registered but disabled in phase 1 (07, A20).
TeamStageSpec.title: TeamStageSpec

UpdateTaskConfigInput.description:
Replaces the task's configuration. `base_config_version` is the version the caller read; a newer one in
place means the caller decided on stale data and gets CONFIG_VERSION_CONFLICT.
UpdateTaskConfigInput.title: UpdateTaskConfigInput
